title.zh: 单值接合的共同操作结构
title.en: Common operational structure for functional joining

statement.en: Where a pair of fragments joins into at most one fragment, two descriptions whose codes identify exactly the fragments passing the same tests each read a functional joining of codes, aligned one to one on used codes, the alignment carrying one reading onto the other.
statement.zh: 一对片段至多结合成一个片段时，编码恰好认同通过相同检验之片段的两个描述，各自读出编码上的函数性结合，在已用编码上一一对齐，对齐把一个读法带到另一个。

laws.en: A joining is functional where each pair joins into at most one fragment. Read through a description, codes a and b join into c where fragments with those codes join into one with code c; a code is used where some fragment has it, and codes of two descriptions are aligned where one fragment has both.
laws.zh: 结合是函数性的，是指每对至多结合成一个片段。经描述读出，编码 a 与 b 结合成 c，是指具这些编码的片段结合成编码为 c 者；一编码被使用，是指某片段有它；两个描述的编码对齐，是指同一片段兼有二者。

laws.en: For a functional joining and two descriptions whose codes are equal exactly for fragments passing the same tests of the joining's frame (the same courses of joinings open from each): each reads a functional joining of codes, each used code of either is aligned with exactly one code of the other, and aligned codes join in one reading exactly where their aligned codes join in the other. No other premise, no finiteness.
laws.zh: 对函数性结合，以及编码恰对通过结合框架相同检验（自各自出发开放相同的结合路径）的片段相等的两个描述：各自读出编码上的函数性结合，任一方的每个已用编码恰与另一方的一个编码对齐，对齐的编码在一个读法中结合，恰当其对齐编码在另一读法中结合。无其他前提，不需有限性。

laws.en: A context is a finite arrangement of partners joined on the left or right around a hole; it realizes what its course of joinings reaches from what fills the hole, and is possible for a fragment where it realizes something from it. Two fragments agree on contexts exactly where they pass the same tests of the joining's frame.
laws.zh: 情境是在一个孔周围从左或右结合伙伴的有限排列；它实现其结合路径从填孔者所到达者，对一个片段可能，是指它从该片段实现某物。两个片段在情境上一致，恰当它们通过结合框架的相同检验。

laws.en: A presentation is exact where each configuration's code reads its answers, and reduced where configurations answering alike get one code; an exact reduced presentation gives two configurations one code exactly where they answer alike.
laws.zh: 表述是精确的，是指每个构型的编码读出其答案；是约简的，是指答案相同的构型得到同一编码；精确且约简的表述给两个构型同一编码，恰当它们答案相同。

hypotheses.en: A functional joining; the questions are all finite single-hole joining contexts; both descriptions are exact and reduced for them, so that their codes are equal exactly for fragments agreeing on contexts.
hypotheses.zh: 函数性结合；问题是全部有限单孔结合情境；两个描述对它们都精确且约简，从而其编码恰对在情境上一致的片段相等。

does_not_show.en: The common operation does not recover the fragments' internal histories.
does_not_show.zh: 共同操作不恢复片段的内部历史。

does_not_show.en: No uniqueness of whole worlds follows: the alignment is unique on used codes.
does_not_show.zh: 不推出整个世界的唯一性：对齐只在已用编码上唯一。

correspondence.zh: 片段、接合及其检验解释同一活动内的关系；数学语义不等于所有问题已被实际取得。
correspondence.en: Fragments, joining and its questions interpret relations within the same activity; mathematical semantics does not establish acquired access to every answer.

history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I3 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine. The new core module Becoming.Joining, importing only Becoming.Likeness, reads a joining of fragments as frames of the spine, through partners, roles and retained references; a description lifts a joining exactly where having one code is a bisimulation of the partner frame, with no premise (Joining.lifts_iff); Becoming.JoiningBridge reads the joining studies as instances. For a functional joining the partner frame is determined, and passing the same tests already is likeness, with no decision (Joining.common_operation). A context of the periphery realizes exactly what its course of moves reaches (realizes_iff_trace), so unique_common_operational_structure holds on the spine as stated (Joining.unique_common_operational_structure_by_core), with no added hypothesis and empty axiom reports (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing) (the periphery proof uses propext). The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope.
